# `packslip completion`

- **Usage:** `packslip completion <SHELL>`

Generate a self-contained shell completion script

Print the script to stdout, and redirect it to a file your shell loads, as the example does for bash. The script asks the installed packslip for candidates, so it needs no other tool and keeps working after upgrades. The setup for each shell is at https://packslip.dev/cli/#set-up-shell-completions

## Arguments
- **`<SHELL>`** — The shell to generate the script for

  **Choices:** `bash`, `elvish`, `zsh`, `fish`, `nu`, `nushell`, `powershell`, `pwsh`

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

**Install bash completions for your user**

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions && packslip completion bash > ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/packslip
```
